properties.displayName: HVMC - Privileged Azure role assigned (Owner / Contributor / User Access Administrator)
properties.description: A high-privilege RBAC role was granted. Risk R04, R07. Playbook PB-02.
properties.query:
let Privileged = dynamic(['8e3af657-a8ff-443c-a75c-2fe8c4bcb635','b24988ac-6180-42a0-ab88-20f7382dd24c','18d7d88d-d35e-4fb5-a5c3-7773c20a72d9']);
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue =~ 'MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION/ROLEASSIGNMENTS/WRITE' and ActivityStatusValue =~ 'Success'
| extend Body = tostring(parse_json(Properties).requestbody)
| extend RoleId = tostring(split(extract('roleDefinitions/([0-9a-fA-F-]+)', 1, Body), '/')[0]), Principal = extract('"principalId":"([0-9a-fA-F-]+)"', 1, Body)
| where RoleId in~ (Privileged) or isempty(Body)
| extend Role = case(RoleId =~ '8e3af657-a8ff-443c-a75c-2fe8c4bcb635','Owner', RoleId =~ 'b24988ac-6180-42a0-ab88-20f7382dd24c','Contributor', RoleId =~ '18d7d88d-d35e-4fb5-a5c3-7773c20a72d9','User Access Administrator','unknown')
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, Role, Principal, Scope = _ResourceId, CorrelationId
